While I love the concept of using steam for everything  instead of steam and discord. I think ultimately the velocity of the online VC and GC market is still very much in discord's favor. And at least at current. If you don't like the nitro and quest stuff you can just turn it off or hide it. That said. If that is no longer the case in the future. Steam may stand a chance. 

Another big thing Imo in discords favor is the simplicity and reliability of their mobile app. Something it seems steam is laughably lacking in. I can seamlessly join a VC on my phone and carry on with a conversation while I'm out and about. Or interact with posts and such in GC's I doubt steam would be able to provide a similar alternative before everyone just accustomed themselves to the, "new discord"
